android_notification_always_help: Stays in the shade for as long as this app holds the mock provider, including when a desktop is driving it over adb. It is the reminder that no app on this device can see the real GPS, and the only Stop button reachable from outside this app.
android_notification_never_help: No notification at all. Playback then only runs while this app is open — leave it and the route stops advancing.
android_notification_playing_help: Only while a route is playing on this device. A desktop driving this device over adb never shows one.
auto_reroute: Route back automatically when off track
build_route_hint: Click the map to add waypoints, right-click one to remove it, Esc to cancel
build_route_hint_touch: Aim the map with the crosshair, then tap Add waypoint.
drop_gpx_here: Drop a GPX or GeoJSON file to import it
follow_vehicle: Keep the map on the vehicle
fork_only_hint: Only understood by a patched Valhalla; stock builds ignore it
heading: Heading
map_unavailable_hint: MapLibre needs WebGL, and this device did not give it one. On an Android emulator that usually means its GPU is on the WebView blocklist — start the emulator with hardware acceleration (-gpu host) or with -gpu swiftshader_indirect. Everything else on this screen still works.
mapstyle_url_help: MapLibre style JSON. Applied as soon as you stop typing.
match_too_different: Valhalla only matched {matched} of the {original} track, so nothing was changed. The track probably leaves the road network.
mock_banner: Real GPS is off for every app on this device.
mock_banner_off: Mocking is off — nothing is receiving a mocked position.
mock_banner_remote: Every attached device is getting a mocked position instead of its real GPS.
mock_provider_setup: Set this app as the mock location provider
mock_provider_setup_hint: Android only accepts mocked locations from the app selected under Developer options > Select mock location app. Pick GPS Mocker there, then come back.
mock_provider_stranded: This device is still being mocked
mock_provider_stranded_hint: A mock location override is still installed on this device, so no app can see the real GPS — and this app is no longer selected under Developer options > Select mock location app, which is the only way to take it off. Reinstalling the app or picking another one clears that selection. Select GPS Mocker there again, then stop mocking to hand the real GPS back.
no_saved_routes: No saved routes yet. Import a GPX or GeoJSON file, or build one from waypoints.
not_a_map_style: That URL did not return a MapLibre style (no layers/sources)
off_route_by: Off route by {distance} — press play to drive back
smart_slowdown_hint: Speed is scaled down for the turn ahead
snap_to_roads: Snap the track to roads when computing
task_allow_background: Allow the helper to run in the background
task_exempt_battery: Exempt the helper from battery optimisation
task_fetch_apk_step: Fetching the Android build of GPS Mocker
task_install_apk_step: Installing the Android build of GPS Mocker
terrain_data_url_help: Tile template with {z}/{x}/{y}, or a TileJSON URL ending in .json
